articles.summary: AI summary: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Assembly Speaker Babar Saleem Swati has written to the provincial police chief a second time demanding details of PTI legislators and ministers held ahead of the party's postponed protest march, arguing police need his approval to arrest sitting members. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi publicly disputed that requirement, and the two traded arguments on X over parliamentary privilege versus equal application of the law.

The Taliban had said their forces killed 28 infiltrators and captured 32; separately, Pakistan's Foreign Office summoned the Afghan envoy over an alleged drone airspace violation.
